name: offlinemask

scripts.check:native: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.desktop:build:native: pnpm typecheck && node scripts/prepare-native-desktop.mjs && tauri build --features recognition-native-release --config artifacts/native-desktop/tauri.conf.json && node scripts/verify-native-desktop.mjs

description: Offline desktop workspace for reviewing sensitive data
